set_length_minimum: 20ish minutes would be ideal, but I'm ok with 5 mn
performance_description:
Anywhere between 15 and 20 minutes would be lovely. I think anything shorter than 15 wouldn't be worth it.
It's just Viv playing a few classics on her piano in her attempts to raise funds. It's live, and I am not very fast, so don't expect dance-bangers ;)
